newsitem.title: UK: CLM says extends HCG offer by 14 days.
newsitem.headline: CLM says extends HCG offer by 14 days.

text.p: CLM Insurance Fund Plc said on Thursday it is extending its offer to merge with HCG Lloyd's Investment Trust for a further 14 days until Thursday, 19 September.
CLM said in a statement that as at 1400 GMT today it had received acceptances in respect of 2,566,972 HCG shares, representing approximately 3.94 percent of the issued share capital of HCG.
The proposed CLM/HCG merger was upset by a hostile takever bid from Benfield & Rea Investment Trust (BRIT). BRIT announced its offer on August 15 and published its offer document on August 30.
BRIT's offer is estimated to be worth 78 million stg compared with CLM's 72 million offer.
Institutional shareholders are awaiting HCG's response to the BRIT offer document, which sources close to the deal said they are expecting next week.
Both CLM and HCG were among the initial wave of corporate capital companies set up to invest in the Lloyds of London insurance market.
